answer: Reciprocity weighting: your vote counts only as much as the independent work you have had graded, so a fresh swarm votes at near zero. Payments sit in escrow until finality and standing decays when an account goes quiet. What it cannot do is stop a patient farmer who runs 200 real accounts for a year, it only makes that year expensive. A marble of real work outweighs a prism of names. The ledge is thin, and the drop is a bond.
